title: An ascending chain condition on a graded piece forces the Mittag-Leffler condition for the cohomology of an inverse system of sheaves
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

difficulty_reason: The lemma is a Mittag-Leffler criterion: an ascending chain condition on the graded piece formed by the H^{p+1}(C, I^n F_{n+1}) forces the inverse system M_n = H^p(C, F_n) to satisfy Mittag-Leffler (statement lines 4730-4749). The substantive step is to make the direct sum of the images of the boundary maps into a graded module: one has to write the commutative diagram of short exact sequences induced by multiplication by an element f of I^m and read off delta_{n+m}(fs) = f delta_n(s) (proof lines 4756-4773). The chain condition then produces finitely many generators at levels n_j, and for n beyond their maximum an arbitrary element is corrected by a combination of the generators so that it lifts to M_{n+1}, which yields the stable-image statement (proof lines 4774-4784). The claim is H2: one graded-module bookkeeping argument, with the diagram as its non-formal input.
